reaction: I liked the return to the larger setting after following individual worlds.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the moon-bearing world through the remaining stones was most worthwhile: it kept the same world in view as the perspective widened.

leastWorthwhile.text: The fragment collision was straightforward and somewhat repetitive after the earlier shattered-body history, although it clearly showed where the debris went.

surprise.text: The exposed gas and dust returned to the nursery rather than simply staying in the planetary system.

arbitrary.text: The exposed inner-disk action’s destination was not obvious beforehand, although the result explained the physical processes.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the returned material reconnects with the wider encounter; that ending was more interesting to me than the straightforward debris collision.
